svg.title: OmniGameArena: game regimes, heterogeneous agents, and three-level evaluation
svg.desc: Seven Solo, three PvP and two Coop games. Commercial VLMs, open-weight VLMs and specialized game policies use keyboard, mouse or gamepad interfaces in the same UE5 environment. Three evaluation levels are illustrated on LastStand: cold-start score, Improvement Dynamics Curve, and transfer test.
